tools.name: bid_checklist
tools.description: Get six items to compare in a home-project bid and optional trade-specific preparation. Omit trade for the general checklist; the answer's trade is then null. The answer includes sourceUrl.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Every US ZIP can post a job. Homeowners anywhere in the US can post a job; once you send it, InstaBids finds contractors to bid on it. Returns guidance and whether the input is a US ZIP, plus nearby town pages. Get the answer for a five-digit ZIP, and list towns with an InstaBids town page for a fiv

tools.name: permit_facts
tools.description: Read sourced local permit facts, with the date each rule was checked; unpublished rules get guidance to ask your bidder and confirm local requirements. Homeowners anywhere in the US can post a job; once you send it, InstaBids finds contractors to bid on it.

tools.name: start_job
tools.description: Use this when a homeowner wants contractor bids on a home repair or improvement job in the US. Creates a private draft from their description and five-digit ZIP and returns a one-hour link for the homeowner to open. Nothing reaches a contractor until the homeowner confirms their email and sends it.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Use this after start_job returned a statusHandle, to see whether the homeowner has sent the job and how many bids have arrived. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: how_instabids_works, check_service_area, permit_facts, start_job, how_contractors_join · Private data: how_instabids_works, start_job · Public sink: check_service_area, permit_facts, start_job · Destructive: how_instabids_works, how_contractors_join.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: how_instabids_works, check_service_area, permit_facts, start_job, how_contractors_join · Private data: how_instabids_works, start_job · Public sink: check_service_area, permit_facts, start_job · Destructive: how_instabids_works, how_contractors_join

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "bid_checklist" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
